item.title: Democratic Party Poised to Retake ‘Nakdong River Belt’ After Eight Years (민주, 8년 만에 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 탈환하나)
item.description:
Democratic Party Poised to Retake ‘Nakdong River Belt’ After Eight Years (민주, 8년 만에 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 탈환하나)

In the elections for the mayors of Yangsan and Gimhae in South Gyeongsang Province, as well as the district head of Gangseo-gu in Busan, as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, candidates from the Democratic Party of Korea were leading the incumbent heads from the People Power Party. These three areas are part of the so-called ‘Nakdong River Belt,’ a region where support for the Democratic Party and the People Power Party has traditionally been closely contested. Analysts suggest that the Democratic Party is now in a strong position to sweep all three seats—eight years after it last achieved a full victory in the 2018 local elections. (경남 양산·김해시장 선거와 부산 강서구청장 선거에선 개표 결과 4일 오전 2시 기준 더불어민주당 후보들이 국민의힘 소속 현직 단체장을 앞섰다. 세 곳은 전통적으로 민주당과 국민의힘 지지세가 팽팽한 이른바 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 지역이다. 2018년 지방선거 때 민주당 후보들이 전부 당선된 지 8년 만에 민주당이 석권할 가능성이 커졌다는 분석이 나왔다.)

As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, based on the National Election Commission’s tally, in the Yangsan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Cho Mun-gwan led with 51.48% of the vote, outpacing People Power Party candidate Na Dong-yeon, who received 48.51%, with 36.84% of the votes counted. Candidate Cho, a former businessman, has served as a provincial councilor in South Gyeongsang Province and as vice president of the Democratic Research Institute. This is his first bid for the Yangsan mayoralty. Candidate Na, who is locked in a tight race until the end, is the incumbent mayor, seeking what is known as a ‘stepping-stone fourth term.’ In local political circles, there is analysis that “With former President Moon Jae-in’s private residence in Yangsan, the Democratic Party’s support base is formidable, and the high approval ratings of the ruling party are also having an impact.” (4일 오전 2시 현재 중앙선거관리위원회 집계 결과, 양산시장 선거에선 민주당 조문관 후보가 51.48% 득표율로 48.51%를 얻은 국민의힘 나동연 후보에 앞섰다. 개표율은 36.84%다. 조 후보는 기업인 출신으로 경남도의원, 민주연구원 부원장 등을 지냈다. 양산시장 선거에는 처음 출마했다. 막판까지 경합을 벌이고 있는 나 후보는 이른바 ‘징검다리 4선’에 도전한 현직 시장이다. 지역 정가에선 “양산에는 문재인 전 대통령 사저가 있어 민주당 지지세가 만만치 않은데다 여당의 높은 지지도가 영향을 미치고 있다”는 분석이 나온다.)

In the Gimhae mayoral election, at the same time (with 20.99% of votes counted), Democratic Party candidate Jeong Young-du secured 63.8% of the vote, leading incumbent mayor and People Power Party candidate Hong Tae-yong (36.19%). Gimhae, the hometown of former President Roh Moo-hyun, has a population of 530,000, making it the second-largest city in South Gyeongsang Province after Changwon. Candidate Jeong, who holds the lead, stated, “If elected, I will remember the reprimands and scoldings longer and more heavily than the cheers of support,” adding, “I will dedicate all my efforts to flawlessly accomplish Gimhae’s key tasks.” (김해시장 선거에서는 같은 시각(개표율 20.99%) 민주당 정영두 후보가 득표율 63.8%를 얻어 현직 시장인 국민의힘 홍태용 후보(36.19%)를 앞섰다. 노무현 전 대통령의 고향인 김해는 인구 53만명으로 경남에서 창원에 이어 둘째로 큰 도시다. 선두를 달리고 있는 정 후보는 “당선되면 응원의 함성보다 질책과 꾸지람을 더 오래, 더 무겁게 기억하겠다”며 “모든 역량을 쏟아부어 김해의 핵심 과제들을 차질 없이 완수하겠다”고 했다.)

In the Busan Gangseo-gu district head election, which had 65.92% of votes counted at the same time, Democratic Party candidate Park Sang-joon led with 55.41% of the vote, surpassing incumbent district head and People Power Party candidate Kim Hyung-chan (44.58%) to hold first place. Gangseo-gu was the only one of Busan’s 16 districts and counties where Democratic Party candidate Lee Jae-myung topped the vote in last year’s presidential election. Candidate Park, a former three-term Gangseo-gu councilor, was elected as a Liberty Korea Party candidate in the 2017 by-election and ran as an independent in 2018 and 2022. Candidate Park said, “If elected, I will leverage the power of the ruling party and bring the full budget of Busan city to Gangseo-gu,” adding, “I will attract the new Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries building and ocean-related public institutions to create new growth engines.” (같은 시각 개표율 65.92%를 기록한 부산 강서구청장 선거에서도 민주당 박상준 후보가 55.41% 득표율로 현직 구청장인 국민의힘 김형찬 후보(44.58%)를 제치고 1위를 달리고 있다. 강서구는 지난해 대선에서 이재명 민주당 후보가 부산 16개 구·군 중 유일하게 1위를 차지한 곳이다. 박 후보는 3선 강서구의원 출신이다. 2017년 재선거엔 자유한국당 후보로, 2018년과 2022년엔 무소속으로 당선됐다. 박 후보는 “당선되면 집권 여당의 힘과 부산시의 전폭적인 예산을 강서구로 끌어오겠다”며 “해양수산부 신청사와 해양 관련 공공기관을 유치해 새로운 성장 동력으로 삼겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ulsan Dong-gu Mayor Race: People Power Party vs. Progressive Party in Tight Contest (울산 동구청장, 국힘·진보당 접전)
item.description:
Ulsan Dong-gu Mayor Race: People Power Party vs. Progressive Party in Tight Contest (울산 동구청장, 국힘·진보당 접전)

As of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 91.83% of votes counted), the Ulsan Dong-gu mayoral election sees a close race between People Power Party candidate Cheon Ki-ok (43.27% of the vote) and Progressive Party candidate Park Mun-ok (42.49%). (울산 동구청장 선거에서는 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 91.83%) 국민의힘 천기옥 후보(득표율 43.27%)와 진보당 박문옥 후보(42.49%)가 접전을 벌였다.)

This is Cheon's third bid for the Dong-gu mayoral position. In the 2011 by-election for Dong-gu mayor, she ran as an independent and placed third. In the 2022 election, she lost to Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon. She has previously served as a Ulsan city councilor. (천 후보는 이번 동구청장 선거가 세 번째 도전이다. 2011년 동구청장 재보궐선거 때 무소속으로 출마해 3위를 했다. 2022년 동구청장 선거에서는 진보당 김종훈 후보에게 밀려 낙선했다. 울산시의원을 지냈다.)

Park is a former Dong-gu district councilor, running for mayor for the first time. If Park wins, the Progressive Party would produce a second consecutive mayor in this district. (박 후보는 울산 동구의원 출신이다. 이번에 처음 동구청장 선거에 출마했다. 박 후보가 당선되면 진보당은 이곳에서 두 차례 연속 구청장을 배출하게 된다.)

Ulsan Dong-gu is home to HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' headquarters and numerous shipbuilding-related small and medium-sized enterprises. With a large number of shipyard workers, it is considered a "progressive stronghold." Local political circles analyze that "the unification of progressive candidates influenced voters in Dong-gu." The Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party confirmed Park as the unified candidate for Dong-gu mayor on the 15th of last month. (울산 동구는 HD현대중공업 본사와 조선 관련 중소기업이 밀집한 지역이다. 조선업 노동자가 많아 ‘진보 강세 지역’으로 분류된다. 지역 정가에선 “진보 진영 후보 단일화가 동구 표심에 영향을 미쳤다”는 분석이 나온다. 더불어민주당과 진보당은 지난달 15일 박 후보를 동구청장 단일 후보로 확정했다.)

Cheon has pledged to strengthen worker support centers to enhance safety at industrial sites like shipbuilding and support worker welfare, and to establish a "life-cycle complex cultural center" to care for children, adolescents, and parents. Park has promised to lower tolls on the Ulsan Bridge connecting Dong-gu and Nam-gu, and to introduce a Dong-gu-style public bus system. (천 후보는 노동자 지원센터를 강화해 조선업 등 산업 현장의 안전과 노동자 복지를 지원하고, ‘생애주기 복합문화센터’를 건립해 아동부터 청소년, 부모까지 챙기겠다고 공약했다. 박 후보는 동구와 남구를 잇는 울산대교 통행료 인하, 동구형 공공버스 도입 등을 공약으로 내걸었다.)

Choo Kyung-ho of People Power Party Likely to Win Daegu Mayoral Election... Democratic Party’s Kim Boo-kyum Concedes Defeat (국힘 추경호, 대구시장 당선 유력... 민주 김부겸 낙선인사)

item.title: PK is a Nail-Biting Battle… Busan and South Gyeongsang Both in a ‘1% Fight’ Until Dawn (PK는 피말리는 접전… 부산도 경남도 새벽까지 ‘1% 싸움’)
item.description:
PK is a Nail-Biting Battle… Busan and South Gyeongsang Both in a ‘1% Fight’ Until Dawn (PK는 피말리는 접전… 부산도 경남도 새벽까지 ‘1% 싸움’)

Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang, considered the biggest battlegrounds in this election, showed a tight race between ruling and opposition candidates as of 2 a.m. on the 4th. (이번 선거 최대 격전지로 꼽힌 부산·울산·경남은 4일 2시 현재 여야 후보 간 접전 양상이었다.)

In the Busan mayoral election, Jeon Jae-soo of the Democratic Party of Korea is leading incumbent Park Hyung-joon of the People Power Party, who is seeking re-election. With 81% of the votes counted, Jeon currently stands at 50.89% and Park at 47.54%, giving Jeon a 3.35 percentage point lead. (부산시장 선거에서는 전재수 더불어민주당 후보가 연임 도전에 나선 박형준 국민의힘 후보를 앞서고 있다. 개표율 81% 현재 전 후보는 50.89%, 박 후보 47.54%였다. 전 후보가 3.35%p 차이로 앞서고 있다.)

The Democratic Party invested heavily in Busan in this election. A ruling party official stated, “President Lee Jae-myung, since his days as party leader, singled out Jeon Jae-soo, the only member of parliament from Busan, as the mayoral candidate and later appointed him as the first Minister of Oceans and Fisheries under the Lee Jae-myung administration,” adding, “Park’s strong performance despite allegations of receiving Cartier gifts and other funds from the Unification Church is thanks to President Lee’s support.” However, in Busan, classified as a conservative stronghold, support for the incumbent Park was also formidable. A political source remarked, “The late-stage checks on the ruling party seem to have had an effect.” (민주당은 이번 선거에서 부산에 많은 공을 들였다. 여권 관계자는 “이재명 대통령은 당대표 시절부터 부산 유일의 국회의원인 전재수를 부산시장 후보로 점찍고 이재명 정부 초대 해양수산부 장관으로 발탁했다”며 “박 후보가 까르띠에 등 통일교 금품 수수 의혹에도 선전하고 있는 건 이 대통령의 지원 덕분”이라고 했다. 하지만 보수 텃밭으로 분류되는 부산에선 연임에 나선 박 후보 지지세도 만만치 않았다. 정치권 관계자는 “막판 여권 견제론도 힘을 발휘한 것 같다”고 했다.)

In the Ulsan mayoral election, as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook (49.79%) is leading People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-kyum (44.77%). Kim took a significant lead around 11 p.m. on the 3rd, making his victory seem likely, but by early morning the race tightened again. In 2018, Ulsan had its first Democratic Party mayor, Song Cheol-ho, who defeated Kim Ki-hyun of the Liberty Korea Party by a 12 percentage point margin. (울산시장 선거에서는 4일 2시 현재 민주당 김상욱(49.79%) 후보가 로 국민의힘 김두겸(44.77%) 후보를 앞서고 있다. 김 후보는 3일 저녁 11시쯤부터 크게 앞서나가며 당선이 유력해졌지만 다음날 새벽 다시 접전 양상을 보였다. 울산은 2018년 송철호 전 시장이 첫 민주당 소속 시장이었다. 당시 송 전 시장은 김기현 자유한국당 후보를 12%p 격차로 이겼다.)

Kim, a lawyer, was elected as a member of parliament for Ulsan’s Nam District Gap in the 2024 general election under the People Power Party banner. However, he left the party after supporting the impeachment of President Yoon Seok-yeol during the martial law crisis that year. In last year’s presidential election, he declared support for President Lee Jae-myung, joined the Democratic Party, and has now secured the Ulsan mayoralty under that party. A ruling party official said, “Although Kim switched parties, Ulsan has effectively bolstered the Democratic Party’s narrative of judging the insurrection.” In the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Ulsan’s Nam District Gap—a conservative stronghold that Kim once represented—the ruling and opposition candidates were also in an extremely tight race as of 2 a.m. on the 4th. (변호사인 김 후보는 2024년 총선 때 울산 남갑에서 국민의힘 간판으로 국회의원에 당선됐다. 하지만 그해 윤석열 정부의 계엄 사태 때 대통령 탄핵에 찬성하면서 국민의힘을 탈당했다. 작년 대선 때에는 이재명 대통령에 대한 지지선언을 하며 민주당에 입당했고 민주당 소속으로 울산시장을 거머쥐게 됐다. 여권 관계자는 “김 후보가 당을 넘나들었지만 울산 역시 민주당의 내란 심판론에 힘을 실어준 셈”이라고 했다. 김 후보가 국회의원을 지낸 지역구인 보수 텃밭인 울산 남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서도 여야 후보는 4일 2시까지 초접전 양상을 보였다.)

Within the ruling party, Kim’s high approval rating was attributed to his alliance with the Progressive Party. Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party candidate and former district mayor in Ulsan, declared his support for Kim on the 28th of last month after a unified primary. (여권에선 김 후보가 높은 지지율을 보인 이유로 진보당과의 단일화를 꼽았다. 울산에서 구청장을 지낸 진보당 김종훈 후보는 지난달 28일 단일화 경선을 통해 김 후보 지지선언을 한 바 있다.)

In the South Gyeongsang gubernatorial election, which featured a showdown between the current and former governors, Park Wan-soo of the People Power Party (51.39%) was leading Kim Gyeong-soo of the Democratic Party (48.6%) as of 2 a.m. on the 4th. Former South Gyeongsang Governor Kim Gyeong-soo and incumbent Park Wan-soo engaged in a back-and-forth, extremely close race from the start of vote counting. After 11 p.m. on the 3rd, when the counting rate exceeded 25%, the tide turned toward Park, and by 2 a.m. on the 4th, with 64% counted, the gap was nearly 3 percentage points. Exit polls by the three major broadcasters KBS, MBC, and SBS had earlier shown Kim (54.3% leading Park (45.7%). (전·현직 도지사 간 맞대결 양상을 보인 경남 선거에서는 이날 2시 기준 박완수(51.39%) 국민의힘 후보가 김경수(48.6%) 민주당 후보를 앞섰다. 전직 경남지사 김경수 민주당 후보는 현직 박완수 국민의힘 후보와 개표 초반 엎치락뒤치락 초접전 양상을 보였다. 3일 오후 11시부터 개표율 25%를 넘어서자 판세는 박완수 후보 쪽으로 기울었고 4일 오전 2시 개표율 64% 기준으로는 3%p 가까운 격차를 보였다. 이날 개표 전 KBS·MBC·SBS 지상파 3사 출구조사는 김경수(54.3%) 후보가 박완수(45.7%) 후보를 앞서는 것으로 나왔었다.)

In South Gyeongsang, Kim Gyeong-soo succeeded in forming an alliance with the Progressive Party in the final stages, but the race remained tight to the end given its status as a conservative stronghold. On the 27th of last month, Progressive Party candidate Jeon Hee-young withdrew her candidacy and declared support for Kim Gyeong-soo, a week before the main vote. This shifted the race from a three-way contest, where Kim shared progressive votes with Jeon, to a direct two-way match against Park. Kim Gyeong-soo was convicted in 2021 for the “Druking scandal,” a case of manipulating online comments and public opinion, and stepped down mid-term as governor, but was later granted a special pardon and had his rights restored under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration. (경남은 선거 막판 김경수 후보가 진보당 후보와 단일화에 성공했지만 보수 텃밭이란 점에서 막판까지 접전 양상을 보였다. 지난달 27일 진보당 전희영 후보는 본투표를 일주일 앞두고 김경수 후보 지지를 선언하며 후보직을 사퇴했다. 김경수 후보가 진보 진영 표를 전희영 후보와 나눠갖는 3파전 구도에서 박완수 후보와의 양자대결로 바뀌었다. 김경수 후보는 2021년 댓글 여론 조작 사건인 ‘드루킹 사건’으로 유죄가 확정돼 임기 중 지사직을 내려놓았지만, 윤석열 정부 때 특별사면·복권됐다.)

The Democratic Party also performed well in the local mayoral and gubernatorial elections (heads of districts, cities, and counties) in Busan and Ulsan. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, Democratic Party candidates were likely to win in 6 out of 16 areas in Busan, 1 out of 5 in Ulsan, and 6 out of 18 in South Gyeongsang—a total of 13 areas across the Busan-Ulsan-South Gyeongsang region. While this is an improvement over 2022, when the People Power Party swept all local leadership posts in the region, it is weaker than 2018, when the Democratic Party was the ruling party and won 25 of 39 positions in Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang. (민주당은 부산, 울산 기초단체장(구·시·군의 장) 선거에서도 선전했다. 이날 2시 기준 부산에선 16곳 중 6곳, 울산에선 5곳 중 1곳, 경남에선 18곳 중 6석에서 민주당 후보 당선 가능성이 높다. 부울경 통틀어 13곳에서 앞선 것이다. 부울경 기초단체장 선거에서 국민의힘이 모두 휩쓸었던 2022년보단 나은 성적이지만, 지금처럼 민주당이 집권 여당이었던 2018년(부울경 39곳 중 25곳 승리)보다는 저조하다.)

item.title: As ballot count surpasses 50%, Daegu mayoral race leans toward Choo Kyung-ho (대구시장은 개표율 50% 넘기면서 추경호로 기울어져)
item.description:
As ballot count surpasses 50%, Daegu mayoral race leans toward Choo Kyung-ho (대구시장은 개표율 50% 넘기면서 추경호로 기울어져)

In the Daegu mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho is pulling ahead of Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum in vote difference, making his victory all but certain. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 61.28% of votes counted), Choo had 51.91% of the vote, leading Kim (47.05%) by 4.86 percentage points. The two candidates were neck-and-neck until late at night, but as the ballot count exceeded 50%, the likelihood of Choo’s victory increased significantly. (대구시장 선거에서는 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 더불어민주당 김부겸 후보와 표 차이를 벌리며 당선이 확실시된다. 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 61.28%) 추 후보가 51.91%를 득표해 김 후보(47.05%)를 4.86%포인트 앞섰다. 두 후보는 이날 밤늦게까지 경합했으나, 개표율이 50%를 넘어가며 추 후보 승리 가능성이 크게 높아졌다.)

Daegu has been called a "conservative stronghold," as no Democratic Party-affiliated candidate has ever won a local election there since the first local elections in 1995. If Choo is elected, it would be a dramatic comeback from his early disadvantage. Early in the campaign, opinion polls showed Kim with a considerable lead, but Choo gradually closed the gap, making it a tight race within the margin of error. As Choo’s victory became likely in the early hours of the morning, he said, “The collective support is being reflected in the current ballot count.” (대구는 1995년 제1회 지방선거 이후 현재까지 단 한 번도 민주당 계열 후보가 당선된 적이 없어 ‘보수의 텃밭’으로 불린다. 추 후보가 당선되면 선거 초반 열세를 뒤집는 역전극이 된다. 선거 초반 여론조사에선 김 후보가 상당히 앞섰으나, 이후 추 후보가 추격해 오차 범위 안팎의 접전이 벌어지기 시작했다. 추 후보는 이날 새벽 당선이 유력해지자 “마음을 모아준 것이 현재 개표 상황에 반영되고 있다”고 했다.)

According to exit polls from three broadcasters on the 3rd, Choo led Kim by 0.8 percentage points, with 49.9% to Kim’s 49.1%. Choo, a former economic bureaucrat, was first elected in the Dalseong district of Daegu in the 20th general election in 2016 and has served three consecutive terms. During the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, he served as the first Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy and Minister of Economy and Finance, as well as the floor leader of the People Power Party. In April, he defeated lawmaker Yoo Young-ha in the party primary runoff to advance to the general election. <<> Kim, Choo’s rival, was first elected as a candidate for the Grand National Party (now the People Power Party) in Gunpo, Gyeonggi Province, during the 16th general election in 2000. He later switched to the Uri Party (now the Democratic Party) and served three terms through the 18th general election. He ran in Daegu’s Suseong-gu District in the 19th general election but lost, and also lost the Daegu mayoral election two years later. However, he was elected to a fourth term in the 20th general election by defeating former Gyeonggi Governor Kim Moon-soo in the Suseong-gu District. He later served as Prime Minister during the Moon Jae-in administration. <<> Meanwhile, in the Gyeongbuk Province gubernatorial election, People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo, seeking a third term, appeared certain of victory as of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 71.42% of votes counted), winning 67.27% of the vote. He led Democratic Party candidate Oh Jung-ki, who had 32.72%, by over 30 percentage points. As his victory became likely, Lee said, “This victory is an order from the people to protect Gyeongbuk and make it the center of Korea’s local era,” adding, “I will turn scattered strengths into energy to open Gyeongbuk’s future.” <<> (3일 방송 3사 출구 조사 결과 추 후보는 49.9%로 김 후보(49.1%)를 0.8%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 경제 관료 출신인 추 후보는 2016년 20대 총선 때 대구 달성에서 당선돼 내리 3선을 했다. 윤석열 정부 땐 초대 경제부총리 겸 기획재정부 장관, 국민의힘 원내대표를 역임했다. 지난 4월 당 경선 결선에서 유영하 의원을 꺾고 본선에 나왔다.)

item.title: In the First Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Mayoral Election, the Ruling Party's Min Hyung-bae Defeats Lee Jung-hyun (초대 전남·광주통합시장, 與 민형배가 이정현 누르고 당선)
item.description:
In the First Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Mayoral Election, the Ruling Party's Min Hyung-bae Defeats Lee Jung-hyun (초대 전남·광주통합시장, 與 민형배가 이정현 누르고 당선)

In the Jeonbuk Governor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek is leading independent Kim Kwan-young and appears likely to win. Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, who expelled Kim from the party amid allegations of "proxy fee payments" and has been in conflict with him, has at least relieved some pressure. (전북지사 선거에선 더불어민주당 이원택 후보가 무소속 김관영 후보에 앞서며 당선이 유력하다. ‘대리비 지급 의혹’으로 김 후보를 민주당에서 제명한 뒤 김 후보와 대립해 온 정청래 민주당 대표는 일단 부담을 덜게 됐다.)

As of 2:00 p.m. on the 4th (vote count rate 63.07%), candidate Lee Won-taek leads with 51.4%, ahead of Kim Kwan-young (41.77%) by 9.63 percentage points (p). This Jeonbuk Governor election has been considered the biggest battleground set to shake the future leadership landscape of the Democratic Party. This is because Kim, who was expelled from the Democratic Party over the "proxy fee payment" allegations, framed this election as a "Jung Cheong-rae vs. Kim Kwan-young" showdown and positioned himself as the vanguard of the "anti-Jung Cheong-rae" faction. With Lee, backed by the full support of the party, predicted to win against Kim, party leader Jung has also eased the burden on his path to re-election. (4일 2시 현재(개표율 63.07%) 이원택 후보가 51.4%로 김관영 후보(41.77%)를 9.63%포인트(p) 앞서고 있다. 이번 전북지사 선거는 향후 민주당의 리더십 지형을 뒤흔들 최대 승부처로 꼽혀왔다. ‘대리비 지급 의혹’으로 민주당에서 제명된 김 후보가 이번 선거를 ‘정청래 대 김관영’ 대결 구도로 규정하며 ‘반청(반정청래)계 선봉’을 자처했기 때문이다. 당의 전폭적 지원을 업은 이 후보가 김 후보를 상대로 승리할 것으로 예측되면서, 정 대표도 연임 가도에 대한 부담을 덜게 됐다.)

In the first unified mayoral election for the Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Special City, Democratic Party candidate Min Hyung-bae secured 79.23% of the vote as of 2:00 p.m. on the 4th, defeating People Power Party candidate Lee Jung-hyun (11.38%) and securing his victory. (첫 통합시장을 선출하는 전남·광주통합특별시에선 민형배 민주당 후보가 4일 2시 기준 79.23%를 득표해 이정현(11.38%) 국민의힘 후보를 누르고 당선이 확실시됐다.)

Meanwhile, as of 2:00 p.m. on the 4th, among the 41 basic local government heads in Gwangju, Jeonnam, and Jeonbuk, the Democratic Party is leading in 37 areas. The Fatherland Innovation Party is leading in one area, Sinan, while independent candidates are leading in three areas, including Gangjin, Gwangyang, and Wando. Although polls initially predicted strong performances from the Fatherland Innovation Party and independent candidates, the vote count reaffirms the Democratic Party's overwhelming dominance. (한편 4일 2시 현재 광주·전남·전북 지역 기초단체장 41곳 중 민주당은 37곳에서 1위를 차지하고 있다. 조국혁신당은 신안 1곳에서, 무소속 후보는 강진·광양·완도 등 3곳에서 1위를 기록 중이다. 당초 여론조사에선 조국혁신당과 무소속 후보들의 선전이 점쳐졌으나, 개표 결과 민주당의 절대 우위가 다시 확인됐다.)

item.title: Six-term lawmaker and former party chair, minister Choo Mi-ae... Now the first female provincial governor (당대표·장관 지낸 6선 의원 추미애… 이번엔 첫 여성 도지사)
item.description:
Six-term lawmaker and former party chair, minister Choo Mi-ae... Now the first female provincial governor (당대표·장관 지낸 6선 의원 추미애… 이번엔 첫 여성 도지사)

In the Gyeonggi Province gubernatorial election held on the 3rd, Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, decisively defeated Yang Hyang-ja, the People Power Party candidate, with a significant margin, securing an early victory. Candidate Choo made history by becoming the first female head of a regional government in constitutional history. In the Incheon mayoral election, Park Chan-dae, a key pro-Lee Jae-myung figure and Democratic Party candidate, outperformed Yoo Jeong-bok, the People Power Party candidate. (3일 실시된 경기도지사 선거에선 추미애 더불어민주당 후보가 양향자 국민의힘 후보를 큰 격차로 따돌리고 일찌감치 승리를 확정 지었다. 추 후보는 헌정 사상 첫 여성 광역자치단체장으로 이름을 올리게 됐다. 인천시장 선거에선 친명계 핵심인 박찬대 민주당 후보가 유정복 국민의힘 후보를 제쳤다.)

As of 2:00 PM on the 4th, Candidate Choo had secured 55.30% of the vote, leading Candidate Yang (39.17%) by a margin of 16.13 percentage points. In exit polls conducted by three major broadcasters, Candidate Choo led with 60.4% compared to Candidate Yang’s 34.1%, a difference of 26.3 percentage points. At the election office in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, Candidate Choo and her campaign staff erupted in applause and cheers upon seeing the exit poll results. In contrast, silence prevailed at Candidate Yang’s office. <<> In her victory speech, Candidate Choo said, "I, Choo Mi-ae, have never taken the easy path," adding, "No matter how difficult the path to uphold principles and convictions, I have silently carried out politics with only the people in mind." She also expressed, "I am deeply grateful that the residents of Gyeonggi Province chose my sincerity," and described the result as "the aspiration of Gyeonggi residents for the normalization of South Korea and significant change in Gyeonggi Province." She further promised, "I will tackle one by one the issues of transportation, housing, jobs, and balanced development that Gyeonggi Province faces." <<> Candidate Choo worked as a judge before entering politics in 1995 at the encouragement of former President Kim Dae-jung. She served as a National Assembly member for Seoul's Gwangjin-gu District across the 15th, 16th, 18th, 19th, and 20th terms and chaired the Democratic Party from 2016 to 2018. During the Moon Jae-in administration, she was appointed Minister of Justice in 2020, where she clashed with then-Prosecutor General Yoon Suk Yeol. In the 2024 general election, Candidate Choo moved her constituency to Hanam-gap in Gyeonggi Province, securing a sixth term and becoming the most senior female lawmaker. In the race for the first half of the National Assembly speaker position, she was outperformed by lawmaker Woo Won-shik. <<> In August last year, she was appointed chair of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, succeeding lawmaker Lee Choon-seok, who had left the party amid controversy over proxy stock trading. On the committee, she led the unilateral processing of prosecutorial and judicial reform plans, gaining support from hardliners. Subsequently, she declared her candidacy for Gyeonggi governor, defeating incumbent Governor Kim Dong-yeon and pro-Lee Jae-myung lawmaker Han Jun-ho by a wide margin in the primary to become the official candidate. <<> Meanwhile, in the Incheon mayoral election, based on vote counting as of 2:00 PM on the 4th, Candidate Park Chan-dae led with 55.41%, ahead of incumbent Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok (43.51%) by 11.90 percentage points. In exit polls by three major broadcasters, Candidate Park was ahead with 53.7% to Candidate Yoo’s 45.5%. <<> Candidate Park stated on the day, "I will take the citizens’ command to move from regression to leap, from stagnation to growth, as my directive," and added, "I will immediately launch an emergency 100-day project for restoring livelihoods, as promised. I will not miss Incheon's golden time." He said, "Embracing diverse lives, from air and sea routes to historic old downtowns and vibrant new cities, I will perfectly coordinate with the central government." <<> A former accountant by profession, Candidate Park served three terms as a lawmaker for Incheon’s Yeonsu-gu District. Originally with faint factional ties, he emerged as a key pro-Lee Jae-myung figure as the Democratic Party was restructured under Lee’s system. Elected as a Supreme Council member in the party convention in August 2022, he took the lead in defending then-Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung against legal risks. In May 2024, he was elected as the floor leader of the Democratic Party in the 22nd National Assembly. Candidate Park lost to Representative Jeong Cheong-rae in the party leadership election in August last year, and in March this year, he was single-nominated as the Democratic Party candidate for Incheon mayor. item.title: South Chungcheong, Daejeon, North Chungcheong, Sejong... DP sweeps Chungcheong region's top local government posts (충남·대전·충북·세종… 與, 충청권 광역단체장 휩쓸어)
item.description:
South Chungcheong, Daejeon, North Chungcheong, Sejong... DP sweeps Chungcheong region's top local government posts (충남·대전·충북·세종… 與, 충청권 광역단체장 휩쓸어)

In the June 3 local elections, Democratic Party candidates running for the four top local government positions in the Chungcheong region—North and South Chungcheong, Daejeon, and Sejong—comfortably outpaced their People Power Party rivals as of 2 p.m. on the 4th. Even in South Chungcheong, where a tight race had been expected, the People Power Party fell behind, allowing the Democratic Party to sweep the entire region. (6·3 지방선거에서 충·남북, 대전, 세종 등 충청권 광역단체장 네 곳에 출마한 민주당 후보는 4일 2시 기준 국민의힘 후보들을 여유 있게 따돌렸다. 접전으로 예상했던 충남에서도 국민의힘이 밀려 민주당이 충청권을 석권하게 됐다.)

As of 2 p.m. that day, Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun was leading with 53.50%, ahead of People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum (46.49%) by 7.01 percentage points, making his victory all but certain. Park, a former two-term lawmaker representing his hometown of Gongju in South Chungcheong, has served multiple times as a spokesperson for the party and its election campaign. (이날 2시 현재, 민주당 박수현 후보가 53.50%로 국민의힘 김태흠 후보(46.49%)를 7.01%포인트(p) 앞서며 당선이 확실시됐다. 박 후보는 고향인 충남 공주 지역 재선 국회의원 출신으로 당과 선거 캠프 등에서 대변인을 수차례 맡았다.)

In the Daejeon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Heo Tae-jeong was leading with 56.13%, far ahead of People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo (41.59%) by 14.54 percentage points, securing an early victory. Heo reclaimed the Daejeon mayoralty after four years, achieving a second term. He previously served as an administrative officer in the Roh Moo-hyun administration's Blue House, was re-elected as the head of Yuseong District, and won the Daejeon mayoral election in the 7th local elections in 2018. That day, Heo stated, "Today's victory is a stern order to create a Daejeon where citizens are the masters and to revive the collapsed livelihoods," adding, "I will move forward only focusing on the citizens." (대전시장 선거에서는 민주당 허태정 후보가 56.13%로, 국민의힘 이장우 후보(41.59%)를 14.54%포인트로 크게 앞서며 일찌감치 당선이 확실시됐다. 허 후보는 4년 만에 대전시장을 탈환하며 재선에 성공하게 됐다. 그는 노무현 정부 청와대 행정관으로 일했고 유성구청장을 연임한 뒤 2018년 7회 지방선거에서 대전시장에 당선됐다. 허 후보는 이날 “오늘의 승리는 시민이 주인인 대전을 만들고 무너진 민생을 살리라는 준엄한 명령”이라며 “오로지 시민만 바라보고 나아가겠다”고 했다.)

In the North Chungcheong governor election, Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han garnered 55.20% of the vote as of 2 p.m., leading People Power Party candidate Kim Young-hwan (44.79%) by 10.41 percentage points. Shin, formerly from a conservative party, resigned after overseeing policy operations for the Yoon Seok-youl campaign and joined the Democratic Party in 2024 as a recruit recruited by then-party leader Lee Jae-myung. After three attempts to become North Chungcheong governor since his time with the Bareunmirae Party in 2018, Shin succeeded, saying, "This election result is not a victory for a specific party or candidate, but the outcome of the aspirations of the residents for a new North Chungcheong," and "We will move toward the common goal of developing North Chungcheong." (충북지사 선거에서는 민주당 신용한 후보가 2시 현재 55.20%를 득표해 국민의힘 김영환 후보(44.79%)를 10.41%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 보수 계열 정당 출신인 신 후보는 윤석열 캠프에서 정책 실무를 총괄하다 사표를 낸 뒤 2024년 이재명 당시 민주당 대표의 영입 인재로 민주당에 합류했다. 2018년 바른미래당 시절부터 충북지사 도전 세 번 만에 당선에 성공한 신 후보는 “이번 선거 결과는 특정 정당이나 후보의 승리가 아니라, 새로운 충북을 향한 도민 여러분의 열망이 만들어낸 결과”라며 “충북 발전이라는 공동의 목표를 향해 나아가겠다”고 했다.)

In the Sejong mayoral election, as of 2 p.m., Democratic Party candidate Jo Sang-ho recorded a vote share of 59.68%, leading incumbent People Power Party candidate Choi Min-ho (37.26%) by 22.42 percentage points. Jo, who served as an aide to former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan during his time as a lawmaker and as Sejong's deputy mayor for economic affairs, among other roles. (세종시장 선거에서는 2시 기준으로 민주당 조상호 후보가 현직인 국민의힘 최민호 후보(37.26%)를 상대로 득표율 59.68%를 기록하며 22.42%포인트 앞섰다. 이해찬 전 총리의 국회의원 시절 보좌관을 지낸 조 후보는 세종시 전 경제부시장 등을 거쳤다.)

item.title: The Power of a Local… Yoo Ui-dong Defies Expectations, Beats Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk (토박이의 힘… 유의동, 예상 깨고 김용남·조국 눌렀다)
item.description:
The Power of a Local… Yoo Ui-dong Defies Expectations, Beats Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk (토박이의 힘… 유의동, 예상 깨고 김용남·조국 눌렀다)

In the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul parliamentary seat, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party is confirmed to have won. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, with vote counting in progress, Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea secured 29.12%, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party 33.89%, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party 27.92%, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party 3.03%, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party 6.02%. Political circles commented, "This is a result of conservative voters rallying behind candidate Yoo amid the fierce clashes between candidates Kim and Cho, which split the ruling camp." Notably, Yoo is the only one among the five candidates who is a native of Pyeongtaek and has served as a three-term lawmaker for the district. <<> In his victory speech, Yoo said, "I once again extend my gratitude to the citizens of Pyeongtaek for allowing me to be here once more," and added, "I offer my sincere condolences to candidates Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, Kim Jae-yeon, and Hwang Kyo-ahn, who competed with me." Yoo further stated, "The country is in a very difficult situation. I believe there is a reason the citizens have entrusted me with this critical task during such trying times. I will take my given duty seriously and walk step by step, following the orders given by the citizens." <<> The Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, which was previously a Democratic Party stronghold, was contested in a five-way race. Initially, there were prospects for a unification of candidates—including the ruling camp's Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, and Kim Jae-yeon, and the opposition's Yoo Ui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn—but unification efforts fell through on both sides. Various opinion polls showed Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk trading first and second place within the margin of error, with Yoo Ui-dong trailing in third place also within the margin of error. Exit polls by three major broadcasters showed Kim Yong-nam at 30.3%, Yoo Ui-dong at 30.6%, and Cho Kuk at 31.1%, an extremely tight race within a 0.8-percentage-point range. <<> However, during the actual vote count, Yoo defied predictions and emerged victorious. Political observers noted, "This is the result of the ruling camp being split in half due to the rivalry between candidates Kim and Cho." Although there was even talk of a potential unification within the ruling camp between the two candidates, tensions between the parties were high from the early stages of the election. <<> Throughout the campaign, Cho Kuk's camp persistently raised controversies about Kim Yong-nam's past remarks—given his background from a conservative party—as well as allegations of assault by his aides, land speculation, and operating loan companies under false names. In doing so, they highlighted Cho as the ruling camp candidate. Kim's camp, in turn, characterized these as negative tactics and attacked Cho as a "pseudo-Democratic Party candidate." This fractured the ruling camp into two. The Democratic Party and the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had once discussed a merger, but there was even talk that this election made such a merger unlikely. While pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions openly supported Cho, the pro-Lee faction actively backed Kim, who had joined the party by supporting President Lee in the last presidential election. <<> Meanwhile, the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election emerged as a 'hot spot' due to the candidacy of Cho Kuk, a leading figure in the ruling camp, but the actual voter turnout was low. The final turnout stood at 54.7%, which was 6.2 percentage points lower than the average of 60.9% for the 14 by-elections nationwide. Political circles offered interpretations such as "due to the district's characteristics—a large, urban-rural complex area" and "voters grew fatigued from the continuous negative campaigning." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에선 유의동 국민의힘 후보의 당선이 확실시됐다. 4일 오전 2시 현재 개표 진행 결과, 김용남 더불어민주당 후보 29.12%, 유의동 국민의힘 후보 33.89%, 조국 조국혁신당 후보 27.92%, 김재연 진보당 후보 3.03%, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보 6.02%였다. 정치권에선 “김 후보와 조 후보가 거센 공방을 벌이며 여권이 쪼개진 가운데, 보수 표심이 유 후보로 결집된 결과”라는 말이 나왔다. 특히 유 후보는 후보 5명 중 유일한 평택 토박이로 이 지역에서 3선 국회의원을 지냈다.)

item.title: Defeat Looms Across Key Battlegrounds… Calls for Jang Dong-hyuk’s Resignation Emerge Before Vote Counting Even Ends (경합지 곳곳서 패색… 개표 끝나기도 전에 ‘장동혁 사퇴론’ 나와)
item.description:
Defeat Looms Across Key Battlegrounds… Calls for Jang Dong-hyuk’s Resignation Emerge Before Vote Counting Even Ends (경합지 곳곳서 패색… 개표 끝나기도 전에 ‘장동혁 사퇴론’ 나와)

With the People Power Party’s crushing defeat in the June 3 local elections, internal conflicts over party leadership are expected to escalate. As the party lost in most key battlegrounds, some lawmakers have called for Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk to step down, and some members of the party leadership are considering resigning. Jang’s term runs until August next year, but he had previously stated, “My political life depends on the Seoul and Busan mayoral elections.” However, some observers suggest he may delay announcing his decision under the pretext of handling the shortage of ballots in the Seoul election. (국민의힘이 6·3 지방선거에서 대패하면서 향후 당권을 둘러싼 갈등이 커질 전망이다. 주요 경합지에서 대부분 패하면서 의원들 사이에선 장동혁 대표 사퇴 주장이 나왔고, 당 지도부 중 일부는 사퇴를 검토하고 있다. 장 대표의 임기는 내년 8월까지지만 장 대표는 “서울·부산시장 선거에 내 정치 생명이 달렸다”고 했었다. 다만 서울 선거 투표용지 부족 사태 수습 명목으로 거취 표명을 미룰 수 있다는 관측도 나온다.)

On this day, Chairman Jang watched the exit polls from three major broadcasters at the party headquarters situation room in Yeouido, Seoul. When the results showed the People Power Party leading in only one of 16 metropolitan and provincial governor races (North Gyeongsang Province), Jang clasped his hands together with a grim expression. In a somber atmosphere, party leadership figures began leaving one by one, and Jang himself departed the situation room after 40 minutes. (장 대표는 이날 서울 여의도 당사 상황실에서 방송 3사 출구조사를 지켜봤다. 시·도지사 16곳 가운데 국민의힘이 1곳(경북)에서만 앞선다는 결과가 발표되자, 장 대표는 침통한 표정으로 두 손을 모았다. 적막한 분위기 속에서 당 지도부 인사들이 하나둘 자리를 떴고, 장 대표도 40분 만에 상황실을 떠났다.)

Even before the vote counting concluded, calls for Chairman Jang’s resignation emerged among People Power Party lawmakers. Han Ki-ho (Gangwon Chuncheon, Cheorwon, Hwacheon, Yanggu-eul), a four-term lawmaker, said, “Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk should resign not only as party leader but also from his parliamentary seat.” A lawmaker from Seoul commented, “It has become clear that a party representing only hardline supporters cannot win nationwide elections.” Another lawmaker from Busan added, “During this election, many candidates were deeply stung by the cold public sentiment that said, ‘Because of Jang Dong-hyuk, I can’t vote for the People Power Party.’” (이날 개표가 끝나기도 전에 국민의힘 의원들 사이에선 장 대표 사퇴 주장이 나왔다. 4선인 한기호(강원 춘천·철원·화천·양구을) 의원은 “장동혁 대표는 당 대표가 아니라 의원직에서 사퇴해야 한다”고 했다. 서울 지역 한 의원은 “강성 지지층만 대변해서는 전국 단위 선거를 치를 수 없다는 점이 명확해졌다”고 했고, 부산 지역의 또 다른 의원도 “이번 선거 과정에서 많은 후보들이 ‘장동혁 때문에 국민의힘은 찍어줄 수 없다’는 차가운 민심에 가슴을 쳤다”고 말했다.)

Floor Leader Song Eon-seok is reportedly expected to soon announce his position, including a potential resignation. If Song steps down, the calls for Jang’s resignation from both within and outside the party are likely to intensify. A People Power Party lawmaker from the former pro-Yoon faction said, “In the process of electing a new floor leader, candidates will inevitably have to differentiate themselves from Chairman Jang. He may want to hold on, but he has reached a point where he can no longer endure.” (송언석 원내대표는 조만간 사퇴까지 포함한 거취 표명에 나설 것으로 전해졌다. 송 원내대표가 물러나면 장 대표를 향한 당 안팎의 사퇴 요구는 거세질 전망이다. 옛 친윤계인 국민의힘 한 의원은 “새 원내대표를 뽑는 과정에서 후보들은 장 대표와의 차별화에 나설 수밖에 없다”며 “장 대표는 버티고 싶겠지만, 더는 버틸 수 없는 지경까지 왔다”고 했다.)

On the other hand, some within the party’s leadership circle suggest that if the party wins in a few close races, Jang might refuse to resign. The ballot shortage in the Seoul election is also expected to become a factor in the fate of the party leadership. In an emergency press conference that day, Jang made no specific remarks about the election results or his own position, only stating, “Based on the findings of the investigation, the Seoul mayoral election must be held again.” (반면 당권파 일각에선 일부 접전지에서 승리한다면 장 대표가 사퇴를 거부할 가능성도 제기되고 있다. 서울 선거 투표용지 부족 사태 또한 국민의힘 지도부 진퇴에 변수로 작용할 전망이다. 장 대표는 이날 긴급 기자회견에서 선거 결과나 본인 거취에 대한 별다른 언급 없이 “진상 파악 결과에 따라서 서울시장 선거는 다시 실시해야만 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: In Jeonbuk Nomination Controversy, Pro-Chung Lee Won-taek Elected… ‘Green Light’ for Jung Cheong-rae’s Re-election (공천논란 전북서 친청 이원택 당선… 정청래 연임 ‘파란불’)
item.description:
In Jeonbuk Nomination Controversy, Pro-Chung Lee Won-taek Elected… ‘Green Light’ for Jung Cheong-rae’s Re-election (공천논란 전북서 친청 이원택 당선… 정청래 연임 ‘파란불’)

As the Democratic Party of Korea is predicted to win the June 3 local elections, there are forecasts that a green light has been lit for Representative Jung Cheong-rae, who oversaw the elections, to be re-elected as party leader. In particular, in Jeonbuk, a Democratic stronghold that was rocked by nomination issues, pro-Chung candidate Lee Won-taek defeated independent candidate Kim Gwan-young, who was seeking re-election, solidifying Representative Jung’s advantageous position in the race for party leadership. <<> Initially, a sense of crisis surrounded Representative Jung as various opinion polls showed an increasing number of tight races. Early in the election, Representative Jung faced a situation where he could not actively engage in supporting campaigns in the Yeongnam region until the end, having sparked controversy over an "oppa (older brother) title" during a rally in Busan. As a result, he focused entirely on the Seoul metropolitan area, Chungcheong, and South Jeolla. A party official said, “There was an atmosphere where people felt burdened by Representative Jung’s election support, to the point where the phrase ‘Jung Cheong-rae risk’ was circulating.” <<> However, with the actual vote count showing the Democratic Party taking a clear lead in the Seoul metropolitan area and parts of Yeongnam, except for some regions in the 16 provincial and metropolitan mayoral elections, internal trust in the Jung Cheong-rae leadership is expected to deepen further. A ruling party official stated, “This election served both as a mid-term evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which has been in office for a year, and as a vote of confidence in the Jung Cheong-rae leadership,” adding, “There will be an assessment by party members of Representative Jung, who oversaw the elections.” <<> In particular, with the Democratic Party candidate virtually securing victory in the Jeonbuk gubernatorial election, Representative Jung has been relieved of the heaviest political burden he had been carrying. Earlier, the Jung Cheong-rae leadership expelled incumbent Jeonbuk Governor Kim Gwan-young over the ‘proxy payment controversy’ and then nominated pro-Jung Cheong-rae candidate Lee Won-taek as the Jeonbuk gubernatorial candidate through a primary. Subsequently, candidate Lee Won-taek faced allegations of ‘covering meal expenses,’ but a ‘no charges’ conclusion was reached, sparking a controversy over unfairness. Various opinion polls also showed Lee trailing Kim Gwan-young within the margin of error. However, with Lee’s election confirmed, Representative Jung has once again secured the support of the Jeonbuk public sentiment. A party official said, “Although Representative Jung could not frequently visit Jeonbuk due to local opposition, he mobilized the party’s full force to shift grassroots sentiment,” adding, “Now, momentum for re-election as party leader will accelerate.” <<> Based on this, Representative Jung is expected to challenge for re-election as party leader at the national convention, likely in late August or, at the latest, early September. Potential contenders for the party leadership race include Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, former leader Song Young-gil, and lawmakers Lee In-young and Kim Yong-min. A key aide to Representative Jung said, “Since this party leader will wield immense power, including control over nominations for the 2028 general election, it will be a fight without any concessions,” and added, “With the election victory, the number of party leadership contenders is expected to increase significantly, but Representative Jung’s strong support among party members suggests he will have the advantage.” In last year’s party leadership election, Representative Jung won the party member vote, significantly defeating then-lawmaker Park Chan-dae, who was backed by the pro-Myung faction. <<> However, the pro-Myung faction, which has been at odds with Representative Jung, is showing a strong determination to win the party leadership race, claiming, “This election is President Lee Jae-myung’s victory, not Jung Cheong-rae’s,” leaving the convention outcome uncertain. A senior pro-Myung lawmaker said, “Even though candidate Lee Won-taek won in Jeonbuk, attention should be paid to the fact that local support for candidate Kim Gwan-young remained high until the end,” adding, “The controversy over nominations in Honam, including Jeonbuk, may persist for a while.” <<> A political insider commented, “Looking at the trends so far, Representative Jung has indeed secured the most advantageous position,” but noted, “However, with over two months remaining until the national convention and factors like the movements of competitors such as Prime Minister Kim Min-seok also being variables, the party leadership race is unlikely to end prematurely.” Prime Minister Kim is known to be preparing to resign from his post immediately after the election and enter the party leadership race. A party official said, “This local election was both an evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration and an assessment of the Jung Cheong-rae leadership,” adding, “From Representative Jung’s perspective, it’s clear that a favorable environment for re-election has been created.” <<> (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거에서 승리하는 것으로 예측되면서 선거를 총괄 지휘한 정청래 대표의 당대표 연임에 파란불이 켜졌다는 전망이 나온다. 특히 공천 문제로 시끄러웠던 민주당 텃밭인 전북에서 친청계 이원택 후보가 연임 도전에 나섰던 무소속 김관영 후보를 꺾으면서 정 대표가 당권 경쟁에서 유리한 위치를 확보하게 됐다.)

item.title: Government Stability Argument Prevails, Backed by Stock Market Records… Disorganized Opposition Faces Judgment (증시 신기록 앞세운 국정 안정론 먹혀… 지리멸렬 野가 심판 당해)
item.description:
Government Stability Argument Prevails, Backed by Stock Market Records… Disorganized Opposition Faces Judgment (증시 신기록 앞세운 국정 안정론 먹혀… 지리멸렬 野가 심판 당해)

Analyses suggest that the Democratic Party of Korea secured its victory in the local elections held on the 3rd, marking one year since the inauguration of the Lee Jae-myung administration, because a majority of voters supported the ruling bloc's arguments for "government stability" and "judgment of insurrection." The People Power Party suffered defeat in three consecutive national elections, following the 2024 22nd general election and the 2025 presidential election. Political circles commented that "this is the result of the People Power Party's failure to reform itself even after the 'Yoon Suk Yeol impeachment' incident, coupled with a desire for stability and expectations for the early stages of the new administration's governance." (이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치러진 3일 지방선거에서 더불어민주당이 승기를 굳힌 것은 여권이 내세운 ‘국정 안정론’과 ‘내란 심판론’에 다수 유권자가 손을 들어줬기 때문이란 분석이다. 국민의힘은 2024년 22대 총선과 2025년 대선에 이어 세 번 연속 전국 선거에서 패배하게 됐다. 정치권에선 “‘윤석열 탄핵’ 사태 이후로도 쇄신없이 지리멸렬한 국민의힘 내부 상황과 정부 출범 초기 국정 운영에 대한 기대감 등이 더해진 결과”라는 이야기가 나왔다.)

The Democratic Party is expected to win not only the metropolitan mayoral elections but also the basic local government head elections. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, Democratic Party candidates were leading in 59.5% (135 out of 227) of basic local government head positions nationwide. In the 2022 local elections, the Democratic Party had only won 63 (27.9%) out of 226 positions nationwide. Public sentiment has reversed completely in four years. (민주당은 광역단체장 선거에 이어 기초단체장 선거에서도 승리할 것으로 보인다. 4일 오전 2시 기준 전국 기초단체장 227명 중 민주당 후보 59.5%(135명)가 우세한 것으로 집계됐다. 민주당은 지난 2022년 지방선거에선 전국 226명 중 63명(27.9%)만 당선됐었다. 4년만에 민심이 뒤바뀐 것이다.)

Notably, in the Seoul district office chief elections for all 25 districts, the Democratic Party was leading in 21 districts as of 2 a.m. on the 4th. This is a complete reversal from the 2022 local elections, where the People Power Party won 17 out of 25 districts. At that time, the People Power Party swept the traditional strongholds of the Gangnam Three Districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa) as well as the riverside districts of the so-called "Han River Belt" including Mapo, Yongsan, Dongjak, Yeongdeungpo, and Gwangjin. However, in this election, the Democratic Party gained the upper hand in most areas of Seoul. (특히 서울 25개 구청장 선거에서도 민주당은 4일 2시 기준 21곳에서 앞서고 있다. 2022년 지방선거 때 국민의힘이 25곳 중 17곳에서 승리했던 것과 정반대 결과인 것이다. 당시 국민의힘은 전통적 텃밭인 강남 3구(강남·서초·송파)와 함께 ‘한강 벨트’로 불리는 마포·용산·동작·영등포·광진 등 한강변 지역구를 싹쓸이했다. 하지만 이번 선거에선 민주당이 서울 대부분 지역에서 승기를 잡았다.)

Experts analyzed the Democratic Party's victory as a result of President Lee's approval rating maintaining around 60%, which allowed the "government stability" argument to operate advantageously. The Democratic Party has recently highlighted the stock market's strong rally as an achievement of the current administration, appealing to voters to "strengthen the driving force of the Lee Jae-myung administration's governance." (전문가들은 이날 민주당 승리를 두고 이 대통령의 국정 지지율이 60% 안팎을 유지하면서 ‘정부 안정론’이 우세하게 작동한 데 따른 결과라고 분석했다. 민주당은 최근 고공 행진 중인 주식 시장을 현 정부 성과로 내세우면서 “이재명 정부의 국정 동력에 힘을 실어달라”고 호소해 왔다.)

Issues such as the government's real estate policies, the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictment" that leaves open the possibility of withdrawing the indictment in President Lee's case, and the administration-level boycott of Starbucks, highlighting the ruling party's unilateral approach to governance, emerged as election issues. This led to an increase in closely contested areas and a consolidation of the conservative support base. Additionally, the "three highs" (high prices, high exchange rates, high interest rates) emerged as negative factors for the ruling party. However, political insiders analyzed that "the heightened security and economic instability caused by the Middle East war, along with the ongoing internal strife within the People Power Party, which should have presented alternatives, strengthened the 'government stability' argument and suppressed the opposition's 'government checks' narrative." (정부의 부동산 정책과 이 대통령 사건의 공소 취소 가능성을 열어둔 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법, 정권 차원의 스타벅스 불매 운동 등 집권 여당의 일방적 국정 운영 방식이 선거 쟁점으로 부각하면서 접전지가 늘고 보수 지지층이 결집하는 흐름도 감지됐다. 이와 함께 고물가·고환율·고금리 등 ‘3고(高)’도 여당으로선 악재로 떠올랐다. 하지만 정치권 관계자들은 “중동 전쟁 등으로 야기된 안보·경제 불안 고조와 함께 대안을 제시해야 할 국민의힘의 지속된 내분이 ‘국정 안정론’을 강화해 야당의 ‘정부 견제론’을 누른 것”이라고 분석했다.)

Observers also point out that while the Democratic Party placed "judgment on insurrection forces" at the forefront of its election campaign, the People Power Party repeatedly exposed internal divisions, contributing to its own decline in approval ratings. The People Power Party failed to stabilize itself after the December 3 martial law declaration and the impeachment of former President Yoon, with ongoing internal conflicts involving factions aligned with Yoon and Han, ousting of internal opponents, and infighting surrounding the party leader. Subsequent events, including the nominations fiasco for Daegu and North Chungcheong Province governors and the unprecedented withdrawal of the candidate nomination for the Siheung City mayor, led to further defections from its support base. (민주당이 ‘내란 세력 심판’을 선거 캠페인 전면에 내세운 반면, 국민의힘은 거듭된 내부 분란을 노출해 지지율 하락을 자초했다는 지적도 나온다. 국민의힘은 작년 12·3 계엄과 윤 전 대통령 탄핵 이후 당을 수습하지 못하고 친윤·친한 계파 갈등과 당내 반대파 축출 등 당 대표를 둘러싼 내홍이 계속됐다. 이후 이어진 대구·충북지사 공천 파동과 사상 초유의 경기도 시흥시장 후보 공천 포기 등도 지지층 추가 이탈로 이어졌다.)

As the People Power Party's approval rating fell to an all-time low (15%), raising crisis alarms, voices within the party grew louder demanding Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation. However, Jang refused, stating it would be "inconsistent with responsible politics." (국민의힘 지지율이 창당 이후 최저(15%)로 떨어지며 위기감이 커지자 당내에선 장동혁 대표에게 사퇴를 요구하는 목소리가 커졌다. 그러나 장 대표는 “책임 정치와 맞지 않는다”며 거부했다.)

Kang Won-taek, director of Seoul National University's Institute for Future Strategy, stated, "The People Power Party failed to properly take responsibility for the martial law and impeachment crisis, nor did it present a new vision on future growth engines or youth employment. The election results largely reflect voters' judgment on these failures." Shin Yul, a professor at Myongji University, said, "Rather than voters punishing the ruling party's arrogance, they delivered a harsher judgment on the People Power Party, which, lacking alternatives, was mired in internal strife." (강원택 서울대 국가미래전략원장은 “국민의힘은 계엄 및 탄핵 사태에 제대로 책임지는 모습을 보이지 않은 데다 미래 먹거리, 청년 일자리 등에 대한 새로운 비전을 내놓지도 못했다”며 “이에 대한 유권자들 심판 성격이 크다”고 했다. 신율 명지대 교수는 “유권자들이 거대 여당의 오만함에 회초리를 들기보다는 ‘대안 부재’ 상태에서 내분에 휩싸인 국민의힘에 더 엄중한 심판을 내린 것”이라고 했다.)

As this election was held under the "big ruling party, small opposition" structure where the Democratic Party holds a majority in the National Assembly, the Lee Jae-myung administration is likely to seize local power in addition to its legislative and executive powers by winning the local elections. Consequently, the Lee Jae-myung administration, entering its second year, is expected to see a significant boost in its governance momentum and President Lee's control over the party. (민주당이 국회 과반 의석을 쥔 여대야소(與大野小) 구도에서 치러진 이번 선거를 통해 이재명 정권은 입법·행정 권력에 이어 지방 권력까지 장악할 가능성이 커졌다. 이에 따라 집권 2년 차를 맞은 이재명 정부의 국정 운영 동력과 함께 이 대통령의 당 장악력도 대폭 강화될 것으로 보인다.)

Conversely, the People Power Party is expected to face immense pressure for sweeping political restructuring, including personnel shakeups. The party's reputation of being confined to the "Yeongnam region party" is also expected to solidify. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, the People Power Party was leading in its traditional stronghold of Yeongnam region in the metropolitan mayoral elections for Daegu, North Gyeongsang Province, and South Gyeongsang Province. (반면 국민의힘은 인적 쇄신 등 대대적인 정계 개편 압박에 직면할 것이란 전망이다. 국민의힘은 ‘영남당’에 갇혔다는 평가도 더 굳어질 전망이다. 4일 2시 기준 국민의힘은 ‘텃밭’인 영남권 광역단체장 선거 중 대구, 경북, 경남에서 앞서고 있다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "Violation of Suffrage, Seoul Election Invalid"... Democratic Party: "No Vote Counting Halt or Re-election" (국힘 “참정권 침해, 서울 선거 무효”… 민주 “개표중단·재투표 없다”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "Violation of Suffrage, Seoul Election Invalid"... Democratic Party: "No Vote Counting Halt or Re-election" (국힘 “참정권 침해, 서울 선거 무효”… 민주 “개표중단·재투표 없다”)

The unprecedented shortage of ballot papers occurred most frequently in Seoul, the biggest battleground of the June 3 local elections. The People Power Party stated that among the 17 locations identified as having ballot paper shortages, 14 were in Seoul. (사상 초유의 투표 용지 부족 사태는 6·3 지방선거의 최대 승부처인 서울에서 가장 많이 발생했다. 국민의힘은 투표 용지 부족 사태가 있었던 것으로 파악된 17곳 중 14곳이 서울이라고 했다.)

Among them, at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, voting was delayed and continued until 10 PM that night. Voting took place while vote counting had already begun in other parts of Seoul and election broadcasts were airing. When the National Election Commission attempted to retrieve the ballot box from this polling station, a standoff occurred between citizens protesting and blocking the move and police and election commission staff. This incident also delayed vote counting in Seoul; as of 2 AM on the 4th, the vote counting rate for the Seoul mayoral election was 43.75%. (그중 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소에서는 투표 지연으로 이날 밤 10시까지 투표가 진행됐다. 서울 다른 지역에서 개표가 시작돼 개표 방송이 나오는 상황에서 투표가 이뤄진 것이다. 선거관리위원회가 이곳 투표소의 투표함을 반출하려 하자, 항의·저지하는 시민과 경찰·선관위 직원들의 대치 상황도 일어났다. 이번 사태로 서울 지역 개표도 늦어져 4일 2시 기준 서울시장 선거 개표율은 43.75%였다.)

While voters in delayed polling stations were waiting to vote, the exit poll results from three major broadcasters were announced. Separately from the voting delay, the election commission also began counting votes in areas where voting had been completed. This means some voters cast their ballots aware of the exit polls and the vote counting situation. In the count as of 2 AM on the 4th, Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh received 55.59%, while People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon received 41.75%. (투표가 지연된 곳의 유권자가 투표를 대기하던 중, 방송 3사 출구 조사 결과가 발표됐다. 선관위는 투표 지연 사태와 별도로 투표 완료 지역의 개표도 시작했다. 투표 전 출구 조사와 개표 상황을 알고 투표한 유권자가 있었다는 얘기다. 4일 2시 기준 개표에서 더불어민주당 정원오 후보가 55.59%, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 41.75%를 얻었다.)

The People Power Party called for halting the vote counting in Seoul and holding a re-election. Candidate Oh Se-hoon also stated, "The vote counting should be halted until prior measures for areas where voting was not possible are completed." In response, the Democratic Party countered, "Calls to stop counting votes or hold a re-election are utterly groundless." (국민의힘은 서울 개표 중단과 재선거를 주장했다. 오세훈 후보도 “투표를 못 한 지역에 대한 선 조치가 완료되기 전까지 개표는 중단돼야 한다”고 했다. 반면 더불어민주당은 “개표 중단, 재투표는 일고의 가치가 없다”고 맞섰다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held an emergency press conference around 9:30 PM that day and said, "This Seoul election is one where voters' right to vote and political rights have been seriously violated," adding, "The contaminated Seoul election is invalid. Vote counting should be stopped immediately, and based on the findings of the investigation, the Seoul election must be held again." Floor leader Song Eon-seok joined the call to halt counting and demanded, "Postpone the election in accordance with Article 196 of the Public Official Election Act." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 9시 30분쯤 긴급 회견을 열고 “이번 서울 투표는 유권자의 투표권과 참정권이 심각하게 침해된 선거”라며 “오염된 서울시 선거는 무효다. 즉시 개표를 중단하고, 진상 파악 결과에 따라 서울시 선거는 다시 해야 한다”고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 개표 중단 요구와 함께 “공직선거법 196조에 의거해 선거를 연기하라”고 했다.)

Senior Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook stated, "This could lead to a constitutional complaint." Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo said, "All election commission members deserve impeachment. Resign immediately." The leadership of the People Power Party visited the National Election Commission and engaged in a physical altercation while demanding a meeting with NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak. (신동욱 최고위원은 “헌법 소원으로 이어질 수 있는 문제”라고 했다. 주진우 의원은 “선관위원 전원이 탄핵감이다. 즉각 사퇴하라”고 했다. 국민의힘 지도부는 중앙선관위를 찾아 노태악 중앙선관위원장과의 면담을 요구하며 몸싸움을 벌였다.)

According to the People Power Party's Seoul chapter's own assessment, the ballot paper shortage occurred in five districts (gu) of Seoul: Songpa, Gangnam, Seocho, Dongjak, and Gwangjin. Many of the polling stations affected by this incident are known to be in areas with strong conservative tendencies. In particular, Songpa-gu, which has the largest population among Seoul's 25 districts (650,000 people), saw the most incidents at its polling stations. Bae Hyun-jin, chairperson of the Seoul chapter, said in a phone call, "Many voters who took waiting numbers and waited even tore up their ballot papers and went home." (국민의힘 서울시당의 자체 파악에 따르면, 이번 투표 용지 부족 사태는 서울 송파·강남·서초·동작·광진 등 5구(區)에서 발생했다. 이번 사태가 일어난 투표소들 상당수는 보수세가 강한 것으로 알려진 지역이다. 특히 서울 25구 중 최다 인구(65만명)인 송파구의 투표소들에서 이번 사태가 가장 많이 벌어졌다. 배현진 서울시당위원장은 통화에서 “대기표를 받고 기다리다 투표 용지를 찢고 돌아가는 유권자들도 많았다”고 했다.)

Candidate Oh Se-hoon previously won the 2010 Seoul mayoral election by a narrow margin of 0.6 percentage points over Democratic Party candidate Han Myeong-sook, boosted by support from the three affluent southern districts of Gangnam. For this reason, Oh's campaign urged citizens waiting to vote that day to "please make sure to vote," and told the election commission, "This is a strong warning. Mobilize all means to ensure citizens can vote immediately." (오세훈 후보는 지난 2010년 서울시장 선거에서 강남 3구의 표심에 힘입어 민주당 한명숙 후보에게 0.6%p(포인트) 차로 신승한 적이 있다. 이 때문에 오 후보 캠프는 이날 투표 대기를 하는 시민들을 향해 “투표를 꼭 해달라”고 했고, 선관위엔 “강력 경고한다. 모든 수단을 총동원해 즉각 시민이 투표할 수 있게 하라”고 했다.)

As voting delays continued in various parts of Seoul until late that night, the three broadcasters' exit poll results were released at 6 PM, predicting 51.4% for candidate Jeong Won-oh and 46% for candidate Oh Se-hoon. The election commission maintained that releasing the results was fine since the survey targeted only certain areas. However, Oh's campaign and Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok argued that day, "If people who have already seen the exit polls voted for several hours, that's a problem," and demanded, "The counting process should be stopped." (서울 곳곳에서 투표 지연이 이날 밤까지 이어지던 가운데, 오후 6시에 정원오 후보 51.4%, 오세훈 후보 46%로 예측된다는 방송 3사 출구 조사 결과가 발표됐다. 선관위는 일부 지역을 대상으로 한 조사라 발표해도 문제없다는 입장이다. 그러나 오 후보 캠프와 개혁신당 이준석 대표는 이날 “출구 조사를 이미 본 사람들이 몇 시간씩 투표했다면 문제가 있다”며 “개표 절차를 중지해야 한다”고 했다.)

In contrast, Democratic Party Secretary General Jo Seung-rae stated, "The People Power Party's calls to halt vote counting and hold a re-election are utterly groundless." He added, "Many Seoul citizens not affected by the ballot paper shortage have already voted and the process has ended; vote counting is proceeding through proper procedures, so there is no need to stop it." (반면, 민주당 조승래 사무총장은 “국민의힘이 주장하는 개표 중단과 재투표 요구는 일고의 가치가 없다”고 했다. 그는 “투표 용지 부족 문제와 관계없는 많은 서울 시민이 투표해 마감됐고, 절차를 거쳐 개표가 진행 중이라 중단할 필요가 없다”고 했다.)

Nevertheless, there are claims that the unprecedented ballot paper shortage and voting delays are bound to impact the results of the Seoul mayoral and superintendent of education elections. In particular, it is expected to spark serious controversy over the procedural legitimacy of the election results. This incident could also lead to confusion in elections for district mayors, Seoul city councilors, and district councilors in the five affected districts of Seoul. In races such as district mayor elections, outcomes are often decided by margins of hundreds or thousands of votes. For example, in the 2022 local elections in Gwangjin-gu, the district mayor race was decided by 3,747 votes, a city councilor in the first district by 333 votes, and a district councilor in the first constituency (where three are elected) by 171 votes. (그러나 초유의 투표 용지 부족, 투표 지연 사태는 서울시장·교육감 선거 결과에 영향을 미칠 수밖에 없다는 말이 나온다. 특히 선거 결과를 두고 절차적 정당성 등 심각한 논란을 불러일으킬 것으로 예상된다. 이번 사태가 일어난 서울 5구의 구청장, 서울시의원, 구의원 선거에서도 혼란이 이어질 수 있다. 구청장 등 선거는 천·백 단위 표차로 당락이 결정되기도 한다. 예컨대 지난 2022년 지방선거에서 광진구의 경우 구청장은 3747표, 1선거구 시의원은 333표, 가선거구 구의원(3명 선출)은 171표 차이로 당락이 결정됐다.)

item.title: Following the “basket ballot” controversy… Election Commission only printed ballots for 50% of Songpa voters (소쿠리 투표 이어… 선관위, 송파 유권자의 50%만 용지 인쇄)
item.description:
Following the “basket ballot” controversy… Election Commission only printed ballots for 50% of Songpa voters (소쿠리 투표 이어… 선관위, 송파 유권자의 50%만 용지 인쇄)

Heo Cheol-hoon, Secretary-General of the National Election Commission, apologized on the 3rd for the suspension and delays in voting due to a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations in Seoul, stating, “I deeply feel responsible for undermining public trust in fair election management and offer my sincere apology.” Appearing in a public apology at 9 p.m. that day, Secretary-General Heo said, “We are taking the matter seriously” and “We will identify the causes and problems to establish measures to prevent recurrence.” (허철훈 중앙선거관리위원회 사무총장은 3일 서울 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단·지연되는 사태가 벌어진 데 대해 “공정한 선거 관리에 대한 국민의 신뢰를 훼손한 점에 대해 책임을 통감하며 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다. 이날 밤 9시 대국민 사과에 나선 허 사무총장은 “사안을 엄중히 인식하고 있다”며 “원인과 문제점을 파악해 재발 방지 대책을 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

The Election Commission explained that the ballot shortage occurred because more voters than expected participated, adding, “In the case of Songpa District, it was found that ballots were printed for about 50% of the total number of voters.” The Commission convened an emergency meeting at midnight on the 4th to discuss these issues. (선관위는 예상보다 많은 유권자가 투표에 참여해 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생했다며 “송파구의 경우 전체 유권자 수의 50%(정도 투표용지를) 인쇄한 것으로 파악했다”고 했다. 선관위는 이런 문제들을 논의하기 위해 4일 0시 긴급위원회를 소집했다.)

However, critics argue that the ballot shortage issue cannot be resolved simply with an apology. Under current election laws, objections to the validity of an election can be raised not only by the political parties that nominated candidates or the candidates themselves, but also by general voters. This means any voter in Seoul, not just the People Power Party or Seoul Mayor candidate Oh Se-hoon, can file a lawsuit challenging the election’s validity. (그러나 투표용지 부족 사태는 ‘사과’로 마무리될 문제가 아니라는 지적이 나온다. 현행 선거법에 따르면, 선거의 효력에 대한 이의 제기는 후보자를 낸 정당이나 후보자 본인만이 아니라 일반 선거인도 할 수 있다. 국민의힘이나 오세훈 서울시장 후보가 아니라, 서울 유권자 중 누구라도 선거의 효력을 다투는 소송을 제기할 수 있는 것이다.)

At some polling stations where the ballot shortage occurred, controversy also arose over the Election Commission delivering ballots in ziplock bags or shopping bags. During the 2022 presidential election, the Commission faced criticism for what was termed “basket ballot” voting, as it transported advance voting ballots for COVID-19 patients and those in isolation in simple containers. The practice of election officials placing marked ballots into ballot boxes on behalf of infected voters, rather than allowing voters to do so themselves, also sparked legal disputes. In last year’s presidential election, it was revealed that voters at a polling station in Seoul received ballots, left to eat due to long lines, and then returned, leading to an apology from the Commission. (이날 투표 용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 일부 투표소에서는 선관위 측이 투표 용지를 지퍼백이나 쇼핑백에 담아 왔다는 논란도 일었다. 2022년 대선에서도 선관위는 코로나19 확진자·격리자의 사전투표 용지를 간이 용기에 담아 나르면서 이른바 ‘소쿠리 투표’라는 비판을 받았다. 확진자가 기표한 투표지를 투표함에 직접 넣지 못하고 선관위 담당자들이 넣는 방식도 위법 논란을 일으켰다. 지난해 대선에서는 서울 한 투표소에 줄을 선 유권자들이 줄이 길다는 이유로 투표용지를 받은 채 식사하고 돌아온 것으로 드러나 선관위가 사과하는 일이 벌어졌다.)

Although not directly related to election management, from 2023 onward, high-ranking Election Commission officials were found to have illegally hired their children and relatives, causing public controversy. In 2022, the Secretary-General of the Election Commission was found to have used an anonymous mobile phone to contact politicians ahead of the presidential and local elections, sparking debates over impartiality. (선거 관리와 직접적 연관은 없으나 2023년부터는 선관위 고위 간부들이 자녀와 친인척을 선관위에 부정 채용한 것으로 잇따라 드러나 물의를 빚었다. 2022년에는 선관위 사무총장이 대선과 지선을 앞둔 시점에 익명으로 휴대전화를 개통해 정치인들과 연락을 주고받은 것으로 드러나 공정성 논란을 일으켰다.)

In Germany, during elections held in Berlin on September 26, 2021, serious flaws such as ballot shortages and incorrect ballot distribution were discovered, leading to lawsuits that nullified the election and triggered a rerun. This resulted in changes to the mayor’s position and the number of parliamentary seats for each party. (독일에서는 2021년 9월 26일 수도 베를린에서 치러진 선거에서 투표용지 부족과 잘못된 투표용지 배부 등 심각한 결함이 발견돼, 소송을 통해 선거가 무효화되고 재선거가 치러지는 일이 벌어졌다. 이로 인해 시장과 각 당의 국회 의석 수까지 바뀌었다.)

At that time, Berlin simultaneously held federal, local, and referendum votes. Due to the Berlin State Election Commission’s poor preparation, there were shortages of voting booths, causing voters to wait for hours outside polling stations or receive ballots listing candidates unrelated to their electoral district. (당시 베를린에서는 총선과 지방선거 투표, 주민 투표가 한꺼번에 진행됐다. 그런데 베를린주 선관위의 준비 부실로 기표소가 부족해 몇 시간씩 투표소 밖에서 기다리거나, 자기 선거구와 무관한 후보자가 적힌 투표용지를 배부받는 일이 벌어졌다.)

As in the Seoul city election, ballot shortages led to voting suspensions. When voting resumed at these polling stations, it extended beyond the statutory closing time of 6 p.m., meaning some voters cast their ballots after exit poll results had been reported. (서울시 선거에서처럼 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 일도 있었다. 이런 투표소에서 다시 투표를 재개하면서 법정 투표 종료 시각인 오후 6시를 넘겨, 일부 유권자는 출구조사 결과가 보도된 상황에서 투표했다.)

Opposition parties challenged the election results, and the Berlin State Constitutional Court ruled the entire elections for city and district councilors invalid. The court stated, “Voters were left uncertain about when polling stations would reopen, and it is impossible to determine how many voters simply went home” and added, “In some districts, a difference of just over 100 votes could have been enough to change seat allocations.” The Federal Constitutional Court also invalidated the results of the federal election in 455 out of Berlin’s 2,256 electoral districts. (야당들이 선거 결과에 이의를 제기했고, 베를린주 헌법재판소는 시의원·구의원 선거 전체가 무효라고 판단했다. 베를린주 헌재는 “유권자들은 투표소가 언제 다시 문을 열지 알 수 없는 상황이었고, 집으로 돌아가 버린 유권자가 몇 명인지 파악하는 것은 불가능하다”면서 “일부 선거구에서는 100여 표만 다르게 집계됐더라도 의석 배분을 바꾸기에 충분했을 것”이라고 했다. 연방헌법재판소도 베를린 2256개 선거구 가운데 455개 선거구의 총선 결과를 무효화했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon in Busan North Gap, Yoo Ui-dong in Pyeongtaek-eul Elected (부산 북갑 한동훈, 평택을 유의동 당선)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon in Busan North Gap, Yoo Ui-dong in Pyeongtaek-eul Elected (부산 북갑 한동훈, 평택을 유의동 당선)

The Democratic Party of Korea struggled in the 14 by-elections and re-elections for National Assembly seats held concurrently with local elections on the 3rd. Of the 14 districts, 13 were previously held by Democratic Party lawmakers, but as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, only about 8 were confirmed as wins for Democratic Party candidates. (더불어민주당은 3일 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 14곳의 국회의원 재·보궐선거에서 고전했다. 14곳 중 13곳이 민주당 의원 지역구였는데, 4일 새벽 2시 현재 민주당 후보 당선이 확실시되는 곳은 8곳 정도였다.)

The Democratic Party secured victories in Gwangju Gwangsan-eul (candidate Im Moon-young), Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-eul (candidate Park Ji-won), and Jeju Seogwipo (candidate Kim Seong-beom). Districts where wins were likely included five areas: Incheon Yeonsu-gap (candidate Song Young-gil), Incheon Gyeyang-eul (candidate Kim Nam-jun), Gyeonggi Ansan-gap (candidate Kim Nam-guk), Gyeonggi Hanam-gap (candidate Lee Gwang-jae), and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-gap (candidate Kim Ui-gyeom). In Chungnam Asan-eul, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Eun-su failed to secure a victory. (민주당은 광주 광산을(임문영 후보), 전북 군산·김제·부안을(박지원 후보), 제주 서귀포(김성범 후보)에서 당선을 확정했다. 당선이 유력한 곳은 인천 연수갑(송영길 후보), 인천 계양을(김남준 후보), 경기 안산갑(김남국 후보), 경기 하남갑(이광재 후보), 전북 군산·김제·부안갑(김의겸 후보) 등 5곳이었다. 충남 아산을에서는 민주당 전은수 후보가 승리를 확정 짓지 못했다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party confirmed wins for candidate Yoo Ui-dong (Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul) and candidate Lee Jin-sook (Daegu Dalseong). Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who ran in the Busan North Gap by-election, was also elected. Yoo secured a fourth term, while Han, who had no prior experience as a lawmaker, entered the National Assembly for the first time. (반면, 국민의힘에서는 유의동(경기 평택을) 후보, 이진숙(대구 달성) 후보가 당선을 확정했다. 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보도 당선됐다. 유 후보는 4선에 성공하게 됐고 국회의원 경력이 없던 한 후보는 원내에 처음으로 입성하게 됐다.)

In Ulsan Nam-gap, also a Democratic Party stronghold, Democratic candidate Jeon Tae-jin and People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-gyu were in a tight race, as were Democratic candidate Kim Young-bin and People Power Party candidate Yun Yong-geun in Chungnam Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang. Except for Daegu Dalseong, all districts were previously held by Democratic Party lawmakers. (역시 민주당 의원 지역구였던 울산 남갑에서는 민주당 전태진 후보와 국민의힘 김태규 후보가, 충남 공주·부여·청양에서는 민주당 김영빈 후보와 국민의힘 윤용근 후보가 접전을 펼쳤다. 대구 달성을 빼고 모두 민주당 의원 지역구였다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon, Ousted by Jang Dong-hyuk, Enters Parliament as a Key Figure in Conservative Reorganization (장동혁에 쫓겨난 한동훈, 국회 입성하며 보수 재편의 핵으로)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon, Ousted by Jang Dong-hyuk, Enters Parliament as a Key Figure in Conservative Reorganization (장동혁에 쫓겨난 한동훈, 국회 입성하며 보수 재편의 핵으로)

In the by-election for the North Gap district of Busan, held alongside the June 3 local elections, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon was elected. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 99.5% of votes counted), candidate Han secured 43% of the vote, defeating Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo (41.2%). People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik received 15.8%. Amid the People Power Party's major defeat in these local elections, candidate Han, who had been expelled by party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, has entered the National Assembly, prompting analysis that the reorganization of the conservative camp will accelerate. <<> The Busan North Gap by-election drew national attention as it became a three-way race between Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, a former Blue House AI Future Planning Secretary; People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik, a former two-term lawmaker for the district; and independent candidate Han, a former People Power Party leader. Busan North Gap was the only district among Busan's 18 constituencies where the Democratic Party won in the 2024 general election. The by-election was triggered when Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo, who had been elected three consecutive times in this district, resigned to run for Busan mayor in the June 3 local elections. <<> Candidate Han waited at his home in Buk-gu, Busan, and around 12:50 a.m., he arrived at his election campaign office with his spouse, Jin Eun-jung, to monitor the vote count broadcast. In the early stages of counting, the vote margin between Han and Democratic Party candidate Ha reached 15 percentage points, but the gap began to narrow as in-person voting ballot boxes were opened. Around 1:54 a.m., when Han successfully overtook Democratic Party candidate Ha, Han and his supporters erupted in cheers. After confirming his victory, Han stated, "I will develop Buk-gu, rebuild conservatism, and control the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung administration," adding, "I have once again realized how fearsome and great the public sentiment is." <<> Earlier, at 6 p.m. the previous day, exit polls from three major terrestrial broadcasters showed Han trailing Democratic Party candidate Ha (42.6%) by a narrow margin with 41.6%. However, a JTBC projection poll released at the same time showed Han leading significantly with 48.1% compared to Ha's 37.6%, creating tension within the campaign. <<> Throughout his election campaign, Han called for the reconstruction of conservatism and checks on the Lee Jae-myung government. Han had no ties to Busan and was perceived as an elite from Seoul's Gangnam district with a strong prosecutor image, but in this election, he shed that negative image by sitting on the ground to eat or engaging casually with students. Notably, analysts suggest that his grassroots-focused campaign, which emphasized close ties with local residents, proved effective, in contrast to Democratic candidate Ha's reliance on President Lee Jae-myung and former Busan mayor candidate Jeon Jae-soo from the district, and People Power Party candidate Park's joint campaigning with party leadership and former presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye. <<> Han served as Minister of Justice under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration and later became the People Power Party's emergency committee chair before assuming the party leadership in July 2024. The Jang Dong-hyuk leadership expelled Han in January over the so-called "party member bulletin board" incident that emerged in 2024. <<> With Han's victory in a close race, the issue of his reinstatement into the People Power Party is expected to become a point of contention. During the election period, Han said in a media interview, "I will definitely return, change the party, change conservatism, and change South Korea." A People Power Party two-term lawmaker commented, "It won't be easy to block Han's reinstatement," adding, "In discussions about party rebuilding, centrist and younger lawmakers will naturally bring up Han's reinstatement first." <<> At the same time, it is anticipated that the leadership of People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who led Han's expulsion, will inevitably suffer a blow. Jang had previously said of Han, "Would it resonate with citizens that someone who ruined conservatism claims to rebuild it?" A pro-Han lawmaker within the People Power Party remarked, "Since Han, whom Jang tried so hard to eliminate, entered on his own strength despite leadership interference, Jang must take responsibility for the expulsion." (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러진 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 무소속 한동훈 후보가 당선됐다. 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 99.5%) 한 후보는 43%의 득표율로 더불어민주당 하정우 후보(41.2%)를 상대로 승리했다. 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 15.8%였다. 이번 지방선거에서 국민의힘이 대패한 가운데 장동혁 대표가 제명했던 한 후보가 국회에 입성하면서, 보수 진영 재편이 가속화될 것이란 분석이 나온다.)

item.title: Election Commission: "Ballot Paper Shortage Not Grounds for Re-election... Vote Counting Cannot Be Stopped" (선관위 “투표용지 부족 사태, 재선거 사유 아냐... 개표 중단 불가”)
item.description:
Election Commission: "Ballot Paper Shortage Not Grounds for Re-election... Vote Counting Cannot Be Stopped" (선관위 “투표용지 부족 사태, 재선거 사유 아냐... 개표 중단 불가”)

The National Election Commission (NEC) stated that the suspension of voting in some polling stations in the Seoul metropolitan area on the main voting day of the June 3 local elections due to a shortage of ballot papers does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or holding a re-election. The NEC added that "it is also impossible to halt the ongoing vote counting." (6·3 지방선거 본투표 당일 수도권 일부 투표함에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단된 것은 선거 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다는 중앙선거관리위원회 입장이 나왔다. 선관위는 “현재 진행 중인 개표를 중단하는 것도 불가능하다”고 했다.)

The NEC made this announcement in a statement released after holding an emergency meeting early on the 4th, chaired by NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak. (선관위는 4일 새벽 노태악 중앙선관위원장 주재로 긴급위원회를 연 뒤 낸 입장에서 이같이 밝혔다.)

"We deeply apologize for causing great confusion and inconvenience to the citizens who visited polling stations on the 3rd due to a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations," the NEC said. "We feel a profound sense of responsibility for causing great disappointment and concern to voters who visited the polling stations." (선관위는 “지난 3일 일부 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 해당 투표소에 방문한 국민 여러분의 참정권 행사에 많은 혼란과 불편을 드려 깊이 사과드린다”면서 “투표소를 방문하신 유권자에게 큰 실망과 염려를 끼쳐 드리게 되어 크나큰 책임을 통감한다”고 했다.)

The NEC further stated, "This matter does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or a re-election under the Public Official Election Act," adding, "Therefore, it is impossible to stop the ongoing vote counting." It added, "To ensure the intentions of voters who voted at the affected polling stations can be identified, the ballot boxes should be transported to the counting centers." (선관위는 그러면서도 “이번 사안은 공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”면서 “따라서 현재 진행되는 개표를 중단하는 것은 불가하다”고 했다. 이어 “해당 투표소에서 투표한 유권자의 의사를 확인할 수 있도록 투표함은 개표소로 이송되어야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

The NEC stated, "When the vote counting is complete, the National Election Commission has decided to immediately make the best possible efforts to investigate the truth of this matter and prepare measures to prevent recurrence." (선관위는 “개표가 종료되면 중앙선거관리위원회는 즉시 이번 사안에 대한 진상 규명 및 재발방지 대책을 마련하기 위해 가능한 최선의 노력을 다 하기로 결정했다”고 했다.)

The previous day, an unprecedented situation occurred where voting was suspended at at least 14 polling stations in locations such as Songpa-gu and Gangnam-gu in Seoul due to a shortage of ballot papers. In some areas, voters waited for two to three hours, and some gave up voting and went home. In response, the People Power Party visited the NEC to protest and demanded that the vote counting be halted until the facts of the matter were clarified. (전날 서울 송파구·강남구 등에 위치한 투표소 최소 14곳에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단되는 초유의 사태가 발생했다. 일부 지역에선 유권자들이 2~3시간씩 대기했고, 일부는 투표를 포기하고 귀가하기도 했다. 이에 국민의힘은 선관위를 항의 방문하고 관련 진상이 파악될 때까지 개표 중단을 요구해왔다.)

In the case of the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, where voting hours had been extended until 10 p.m. the previous day, the ballot box had not been moved to the counting center as of 4 a.m. on the 4th due to protests from citizens even after voting ended. An NEC official said, "The ballot box for the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong will not be forcibly transported until the counting of other ballot boxes is completed." (투표 시간이 전날 오후 10시까지 연장됐던 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소의 경우 투표 종료 뒤에도 시민들의 항의로 4일 새벽 4시 현재까지 투표함을 개표소로 이동하지 못하고 있다. 선관위 관계자는 “잠실7동 제2투표소의 투표함은 다른 투표함의 개표가 완료될 때까지 이송을 강행하지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who was visiting the NEC to protest, met with reporters immediately after the NEC's statement was released and said, "This is an election that cannot be recognized. Citizens' right to vote has been violated, and this is a seriously tainted election." He added, "We express strong regret over the NEC's decision. We will fight to the end alongside the people." (한편 선관위를 항의 방문 중이던 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 선관위 입장이 발표된 직후 기자들과 만나 “이번 선거는 인정할 수 없는 선거다. 국민 참정권이 침해됐고 심각하게 오염된 선거”라면서 “선관위 결정에 강력한 유감을 표한다.국민들과 함께 끝까지 싸우겠다”고 했다.)
